summary: Cross-references a macro event calendar (FOMC/CPI/NFP/PMI/earnings season) against TradFi perpetuals + Ondo tokenized equities. The macro calendar arrives as JSON input (per macro_layer.md WebSearch contract). Each affected asset gets an attention score that weights event impact, days-to-event, and asset-event alpha mapping.
core_logic: Accept macro_events JSON (event_type, event_date, impact_level, affected_assets[]).
For each event within horizon, fan out to its affected_assets list.
Match each asset against TradFi perp + Ondo universes.
Compute attention score = impact_weight * days_proximity * venue_bonus.
Rank top-N tickers by aggregated attention across upcoming events.
recommended_next_step: Drop top tickers into structured-trade-plan; cross-reference with earnings-tradfi-scanner for double-confirmation.
